issue.title: Fix enums' name upper/lower case checks

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Change enums' name conversions to use a neutral Locale when converting
the names to upper/lower case to avoid issues with languages that have
different characters for lower/upper cases.

Part of #4327 - ZAP relies on default locale when it shouldn't

issue.title: Correct lower case comparisons

repository.name: community-scripts
repository.description: A collection of ZAP scripts and tips provided by the community - pull requests very welcome!

issue.body:
Change usage of String.toLowerCase() to use a neutral Locale to avoid
issues with languages that have different characters for lower case.

Related to zaproxy/zaproxy#4327 - ZAP relies on default locale when it
shouldn't

issue.title: Correct case checks in HTTP related classes

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Change HttpHeader, HttpRequestHeader, HttpResponseHeader, and HttpSender
to do upper/lower case conversions with a neutral locale.
Refactor (extract methods to HttpHeader) the checks for Content-Type and
normalisation of header name and value.

Part of #4327 - ZAP relies on default locale when it shouldn't

issue.title: Correct case checks in HttpClient classes

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Change HttpMethodDirector and URI to do lower case conversions with a
neutral locale.

Part of #4327 - ZAP relies on default locale when it shouldn't

issue.title: Do not change case when ignoring case in equals

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Replace usage of `toLowerCase().equals` (none using `toUpperCase`) to
`equalsIgnoreCase`, making the checks (correctly) locale independent.

Part of #4327 - ZAP relies on default locale when it shouldn't

issue.title: Use FileNameExtensionFilter where possible

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Change to use FileNameExtensionFilter instead of custom FileFilter where
just the file extension of the file was being checked. For the other
cases correct lower case comparisons to use a neutral locale.
Tweak FilenameExtensionFilter to only do lower case conversion of the
extension once, add JavaDoc, and license header.

Related to #4327 - ZAP relies on default locale when it shouldn't
